meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): inactive while FF-005 is not enabled
gaps: Enable and disable tenant feature flag FF-005.
Trigger user creation, update, and deprovisioning events in the external HRMS.
Verify that no SCIM exchange occurs while FF-005 is disabled and that normal synchronization occurs after enabling it.
